title: Can and can't
summary: Say what you can, can't and couldn't do with the converb `-(Y)p` and *bilmek* (*ýüzüp bilýärin*, *gelip bilmerin*, *gelip bilmedim*), ask politely (*Kömek edip bilersiňizmi?*, *Girsem bolýarmy?*), say what is allowed or possible (*oturyp bolýar*, *mümkin*), and use *hiç kim*, *hiç zat* and *hiç ýerde* with a negative verb.
canDo: Talk about your skills, sports and hobbies
Say what you can't do, won't be able to do or couldn't do
Ask for permission and ask someone politely to do something
Say nobody, nothing, nowhere and never
